lines.text: The Israelites camped at Oboth, Iye-abarim, and the Valley of Zered, then camped on the other side of the Arnon.
At Beer, the LORD told Moses to gather the people for water, and Israel sang about the well the princes dug.
Israel asked Sihon for passage, but he attacked at Jahaz, and Israel took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok.
Israel captured all the Amorite cities, including Heshbon, which was Sihon's city, and Sihon had earlier fought the former king of Edom.
Og king of Bashan came out to battle at Edrei, but Israel struck him down and took his land.
